tasks.title: Design system architecture
tasks.description: Create the initial architecture document for the new design system including component hierarchy, theming strategy, and token system.

tasks.title: Set up CI/CD pipeline
tasks.description: Configure GitHub Actions for automated testing, linting, and deployment to staging and production environments.

tasks.title: Unit test coverage
tasks.description: Increase test coverage to at least 80% for critical components with meaningful unit and integration tests.

tasks.title: Database migrations
tasks.description: Create migration scripts for the new schema changes and data transformations.

tasks.title: Email templates
tasks.description: Design and implement responsive email templates for transactional emails.

tasks.title: Implement OAuth2 authentication
tasks.description: Build OAuth2 authentication flow with Google, GitHub, and Microsoft social login support.

tasks.title: Write API documentation
tasks.description: Document all REST endpoints using OpenAPI 3.0 specification with examples and error responses.

tasks.title: Performance optimization
tasks.description: Analyze and optimize bundle size, implement code splitting, and improve loading performance metrics.

tasks.title: Mobile responsive design
tasks.description: Ensure all components work properly on mobile devices with touch interactions and proper viewport handling.

tasks.title: Error handling improvements
tasks.description: Implement consistent error handling with user-friendly messages and proper logging.

tasks.title: Rate limiting
tasks.description: Implement API rate limiting to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage across all clients.

tasks.title: Analytics integration
tasks.description: Integrate analytics tracking with privacy-compliant event logging and custom dashboards.

tasks.title: Create user dashboard
tasks.description: Design and implement the main user dashboard with customizable widgets, analytics charts, and activity feed.

tasks.title: Implement dark mode
tasks.description: Add theme switching with system preference detection and persistent user preference storage.

tasks.title: Accessibility audit
tasks.description: Review and fix accessibility issues across the application following WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.

tasks.title: Implement notifications
tasks.description: Build real-time notification system with WebSocket support and push notifications.

tasks.title: Search functionality
tasks.description: Add full-text search with Elasticsearch integration and advanced filtering options.

tasks.title: User profile page
tasks.description: Create user profile page with avatar upload, bio editing, and account settings.

tasks.title: Export functionality
tasks.description: Add ability to export data in CSV, Excel, and PDF formats with customizable columns.

tasks.title: Keyboard shortcuts
tasks.description: Implement keyboard shortcuts for common actions with a discoverable shortcuts panel.
